message.content: Builds are slow. Try raising the parallel worker count in build.cfg.

content.text: Theory: the build is CPU-bound, so more workers should help. I raised workers from 4 to 16.

message.content: No change at all. Still 12 minutes.

content.text: The worker theory was wrong: the build is bound by a single serial codegen step, so more workers do not help. Caching the codegen output cut the build to 3 minutes.
